title.narrative: WFP - Support to emergency response for lean season 25/26 and Home-grown School Feeding (HGSF) Programme in Malawi

description.narrative:
The overall objective of this activity is to improve both food security in Malawi by providing food assistance to vulnerable people and access to education by providing diversified daily nutritious meals to primary and pre-primary learners, enhancing school attendance and learning outcomes, while improving agriculture production and increased market opportunities for small holder farmers.
To support food security in Malawi, two key activities will be implemented, beginning with an urgent lean season response for 25/26, procuring, transporting and distributing maize to 520,020 acutely food insecure individuals in three districts. The Home-Grown School Feeding (HGSF) model delivers healthy meals to children, promotes educational outcomes while at the same time stimulating local agriculture and economies through the procurement of food from small-scale producers. This project will reach up to 141,087 primary school children in 123 primary schools with meals.
